about: The officer filling his cruiser at the pump in the police yard behind the station (plans/yard.gd). Placeholder lines written on 2026-11-15 by the civic worker, not the owners' wording. Format: see scripts/talk_box.gd.

choices.say: Whose cars are in the cage?
Can I cut through to the alley?

busy.speaker: npc
busy.line: Busy enough. The pump's slow and the radio won't shut up.

cage.speaker: npc
cage.line: Cars nobody came back for. Some of them have been here a long time.

gate.speaker: npc
gate.line: Gate's chained. Back inside the way you came.
